DECISION: Docker Compose + Traefik on VPS (not K8s, not Vercel)

REASONING:
- Multiple projects on one VPS → multiple domains → Traefik handles ingress + SSL
- K8s rejected: too much overhead for 1-2 apps on single node (etcd, kubelet, API server eating RAM)
- Vercel rejected: Ned specifically wants VPS route
- Docker Compose + Traefik = same multi-domain capability, 20-minute setup

BLOCKER: Google Cloud OAuth project not set up yet — same requirement regardless of deploy target

DB PLAN: Swap SQLite → Postgres in production (change Prisma connection string only, zero code changes)

STATUS (March 2026): Not yet deployed — dev-only mode with Credentials bypass while Google OAuth pending
